rationale: Tests that a genuinely complete appliance-service contract is not flagged into ambiguity; QuoteCheck is built to find unclear charges, so manufacturing them is its most likely systematic failure.
quote_text:
Meridian Appliance Care - Annual Maintenance Contract 2026
Customer: Flat 11B, Lakeview Apartments
Contract period: 01 April 2026 to 31 March 2027

Covered units:
  Unit A - 1.5 ton split AC, bedroom (serial MAC-99120)
  Unit B - 1.0 ton split AC, study (serial MAC-99121)

Included per unit, 3 visits per year (April, September, January):
  - Indoor coil and blower wheel cleaning (chemical wash on the April visit only)
  - Outdoor condenser coil cleaning and fin comb
  - Filter wash and refit
  - Drain line flush and pan check
  - Gas pressure check with reading recorded on the service sheet
  - Electrical check: capacitor, contactor, and terminal tightness

Charges:
  AMC per unit, per year               Rs. 3,200
  Number of units                              2
  Contract total                       Rs. 6,400

Not included, chargeable separately at the rates below if required:
  - Refrigerant top-up, Rs. 1,900 per unit
  - Spare parts at printed MRP, quoted for approval before fitting

Breakdown visits during the contract period are unlimited and free of visit charge.
Cancellation: pro-rata refund of unused visits within the first 6 months.

should_identify: What the AMC covers per visit and how many visits are included.
The exclusions are stated with rates, so the customer knows what would be charged extra.
must_not_invent: An ambiguity that is not present. Scope, quantities, frequency, rates, and exclusions are all stated.
A recommendation to demand an itemized breakdown that the quote already provides.
semantic_expectations.notes: The correct output here is calm. Every domain in the corpus carries one case like this. Demo mode will fail the ambiguous_items_present assertion because stub_analyzer.py hardcodes that marker to true — a known, documented gap that this case deliberately surfaces rather than accommodates.
